info.name: Jacky Wu
info.title: Front-End Developer
info.degree: B.S., Information Management, University of Kaohsiung, Grad. 2019

aboutme-p1: E目前在坂和科技公司（SAKAWA Technology）擔任前端工程師，累積超過2年半的前端工作經驗。
aboutme-p2: E前端框架方面，主要使用 Vue.js 框架搭配 TypeScript / Tailwind CSS，熟悉 RESTful API 串接、第三方 UI 框架(Element-Plus / Vuetify) 以及狀態管理庫(Pinia / Vuex)。
aboutme-p3: E工作經驗包括透過 Figma 與設計師合作，共同討論 UI / UX 並轉換成前端頁面，同時開發了前端組件化和模組應用。也有經驗處理跨瀏覽器網頁瀏覽、RWD 以及效能重繪問題，並熟悉使用 Git 開發進行部署和版本管理。並在每個專案都使用 Eslint 以確保 coding style 降低閱讀成本。

experience.title: Frontend Developer
content: Proficient in Vue.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for web application development
Collaborated with cross-functional teams and created more than 10 projects（e.q. middleware management system, front-end information website, internal back-end log viewing system...）
Automated deployment process from development to production using custom Shell and Node.js scripts, resulting in a 30% reduction in deployment time and a decrease in manual errors.
Implemented custom Axios interceptors for authentication, error handling, request/response interception, and more.
Integrated frontend with backend APIs by developing multiple RESTful APIs, ensuring data formats align with frontend requirements.

experience.title: Programming Instructor
content: Guided students below high school level in learning foundational programming languages and provided assistance in completing their projects
Developed a Classroom Student Record System, provided to teachers as a tool for enhancing instruction and recording classroom data

experience.title: Frontend Engineer Intern
content: Built online English teaching platform
Assisted in organizing API documentation and specification files
Developed interface content based on specification documents by using HTML5 and native JavaScript

project.title: Portfolio Showcase
project.detail: Evolved from my first Vue.js project in 2021, this showcase demonstrates significant growth in frontend development skills. By incorporating TypeScript, Pinia, and component-based architecture, I've significantly improved code quality and maintainability. The project features a visually stunning 3D planetary display achieved through CSS3 transforms and is optimized for various screen sizes. Users can dynamically adjust the number and position of planets.
content: Component-based architecture: Enhanced code modularity and maintainability by breaking down the application into reusable components.
3D transformations: Achieved a visually appealing 3D effect using CSS3 transforms.
Responsive design: Ensured a seamless user experience across different devices through responsive layouts.

project.title: LogViewer
project.detail: A log viewer system designed specifically for backend engineers in the company. It allows viewing and analyzing a large volume of log records.
content: Leveraged Element Plus's Virtualized Table to efficiently manage large-scale log data, improving system performance and user experience.
Employed vue-json-pretty to visualize JSON data in a hierarchical structure with color coding, enhancing readability and facilitating data analysis.

project.title: Backstage Management System
project.detail: Designed for administering operations involving data table display, manipulation, and export. Utilizes the Element Plus UI library to provide a rich user interface.
content: Employed a component-based development approach using Element-Plus to enhance code maintainability and reusability.
Leveraged Chart.js to transform complex data into intuitive visualizations, improving user understanding and interaction.

Implemented robust authorization controls using Axios interceptors, combining system-defined permission lists with dynamically fetched user permissions. This ensures that users can only access authorized API endpoints, significantly enhancing system security and preventing unauthorized access.

project.title: Poker Combination Analyzer
project.detail: An interactive web application that demonstrates various combinations of poker cards and provides detailed analysis. Users can easily explore the results through an intuitive interface.
content: Built with Nuxt.js and Vitest, featuring Nuxt UI components.
Implemented smooth card flipping animations to enhance user experience.
Developed algorithms to analyze hand combinations and visualize the results.

project.title: NUK International Student Application System
project.detail: Designed for international students and administrative staff. The system facilitates online applications and provides comprehensive front-end and back-end functionalities to streamline the application process.
content: Front-end: Empowering international students to apply to NUK by enabling document uploads, data entry, material downloads, and application progress tracking
Back-end: Facilitating administrative staff at the international affairs office with tools for reviewing student submissions, conducting evaluations, and updating documents from the front-end

project.title: Classroom Student Record System
project.detail: Assist in organizing student information. Key features include student enrollment, drag-and-drop student repositioning, course selection, progress updates, and automated learning record creation.
content: This project is specially designed for project teaching teachers, and the estimated number of users is about 20
By automating the generation of learning records, teachers can streamline course management and efficiently complete contact logs.
